findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The QUAT dispenser at the triple sink was tested and recorded at 0ppm during today’s inspection. After troubleshooting the dispenser, the straw that was located inside the sanitizer bucket was found to have detached from the dispensing unit. This straw was reattached and the sanitizer dispenser was retested and recorded at 200ppm QUAT. Ensure that the dispenser is tested at least once a day to ensure its functionality.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The single door freezer in the office area is observed to have an accumulation of ice on one of the shelves and also a variety of food debris on the bottom shelf. Ensure this freezer is cleaned to remove the current accumulation and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The single door silver freezer is observed to have an accumulation of ice along the wall and shelving of the freezer. Ensure this freezer is cleared of all excess ice.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed a syrup spill by the soda line dispenser in the back store room. Ensure this areas is cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of soil residues.
-Overall, a general deep clean is needed under shelving and hard to reach areas. Ensure cleaning is accomplished beneath shelving units at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of soil/debris.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: Observed a mop head being stored in the basin of the mop bucket. The mop was moved into a position that allows for air drying during the inspection. Ensure mop heads are positioned in a manner that allows air drying to occur.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: No hot water was available at the hand washing sink in the customer service area near the soda fountains. Hot water of at least 100F must be provided. Meters underneath the sink were adjusted during the inspection to correct the violation. Make sure this sink is being used for hand washing only and that liquid wastes are dumped in the utility sink in back instead.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.12  (Pf) Provide water of at least 100 deg F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Reference 5-202.12.
